title: sdks: unify auth/retries, improve streaming ergonomics, and parity bump to v1.103.0
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Bump SDKs to v1.103.0. Unifies auth token refresh and retry behavior across Python/TS/Go SDKs, improves streaming API ergonomics (async iterators/generators parity), fixes several small parity regressions, and updates docs/CHANGELOG.
description: Motivation: Multiple SDK inconsistencies were causing subtle bugs for customers using streaming + retryable operations and for long-lived auth flows. This PR unifies auth token refresh semantics, standardizes retry/backoff behavior, and improves streaming ergonomics across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs. Summary of changes below. Checklist: - [x] Unify auth token refresh logic and credentials priority across SDKs - [x] Standardize idempotency and retry semantics (transient vs permanent errors) - [x] Streaming ergonomics: provide async iterator/generator parity in TS/Python and a simpler channel API in Go - [x] Update tests and add cross-language integration tests - [x] Changelog and v1.103.0 version bumps Impact: No breaking API surface changes for typical users; some advanced auth edge-cases have clearer priority rules (documented). See linked Linear tasks ENG-2987 and ENG-3021 for acceptance criteria. Related: SUP-1123 for a customer-reported streaming retry issue.

Priya Patel: The TS streaming generator is much nicer. Please add an example in docs showing cancel() usage and how it interacts with retries.
Maya Chen: Added example and a short note in docs/streaming.md explaining cancellation semantics; CI integration tests updated to assert cancellation propagates.
Diego Alvarez: One of the CI runs failed on flakey python test test_stream_reconnect (timeout). Reran and passed — might want to add a small backoff for the test harness.
Maya Chen: Increased test harness timeout and added exponential backoff in the reconnect test to reduce flakiness. Marking as resolved.
